name: hud_sensor_tracker_reset_hud_for_mission_start
description: HudSensorTracker::ResetHudForMissionStart resets mission-start HUD objective, timer, reticle, and network HUD state. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudSensorTracker mission-start and HUD-manager source-cluster pass because this function depends on several accepted HUD/provider helpers and global UI fixtures.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x418c70 validates objectiveMeterSeconds reset, SetVisibleAndResetMeterFill(0), the network branch through DisableHud, HUD visibility/type checks, top-message display from the active alt weapon description, timer running, layout activation, reticle mode 1, damage-mask disable, and pending skip reset.

Binary Ninja assembly validates the single-player branch: SetElapsedSeconds(0) only when skipTimerResetOnStart is clear, objective flow state 0x64, UI mode/current read sound clears, skip flag clear, and objectiveFlowDeadlineSecRaw as objectiveReadSoundDelaySec plus g_Time_UnscaledAccumulatedTimeSec.

The native smoke covers single-player timer reset, skip-preserved timer reload, and network HUD reset side effects including top-message text, reticle visibility, timer running, and damage-mask disable.
